name: Intraday Wyckoff: the midday range after the morning move breaks AGAINST it (distribution / accumulation)
why: Wyckoff: a range after a markup is distribution — the operators who drove the morning sell into late buyers inside the range, and the break against the morning move is the markdown starting. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_direction_followups.md).
